keyframe_review.note: 26,576 km2, the outline of the Principality of Nitra shape. The Great Moravia page says Nitra 'was ruled autonomously by the heir of the dynasty as an appanage' without a year; 898 is Cliopatria's. No area is on the pages opened, so no infobox comparison was possible.

correction.text: shape unchanged; it holds 900-907, not to 910 ('vassal of Great Moravia (833-906/907)' then the Principality of Hungary)

keyframe_review.note: 26,553 km2, the same outline. The infobox gives 'vassal of Great Moravia (833-906/907)' and 'Principality of Hungary (906/907-1000/1001)', so the row ends in 907, not 910. The Nitra page: 'Archaeological evidence pointing to an early presence of Magyars directly in Nitra has not been found yet'.

region.text: Nitra, 'ruled as an appanage by the heir'

ledger.note: 898: Nitra is held as a separate appanage of Great Moravia by Svatopluk's heir. Page: Nitra 'was ruled autonomously by the heir of the dynasty as an appanage'; the Principality of Nitra infobox lists a 'vassal of Great Moravia (833-906/907)'. Confidence 1: the year is Cliopatria's row, the pages give none and do not name the heir. [Reviewer eu-15-a, 2026-10-25: quotation corrected to the Great Moravia page's words 'ruled autonomously by the heir of the dynasty as an appanage' (no 'later')]

906/907: Nitra passes to the Hungarians. Infobox: 'Principality of Hungary (906/907-1000/1001)'; the Hungarians conquered the Carpathian Basin 'around 895'. The Nitra page: 'Political affiliation of the territory in the 10th and early 11th century is unclear'. Cliopatria's Principality of Hungary shape does not cover Nitra before 911.
907: the Moravian appanage ends with the fall of Great Moravia and the Hungarian takeover.

wars.name: Hungarian conquest of the Carpathian Basin
wars.outcome: Nitra, a Moravian vassal to 906/907 (infobox), passed to the Principality of Hungary. No page opened describes fighting at Nitra.
wars.note: The Hungarian conquest page (opened for other dossiers) has the Hungarians 'attacked and occupied Pannonia' in 900 and defeat Great Moravia in 902; it does not mention Nitra.

certainty.note: The row is one Moravian appanage; no page gives a boundary.

notes: Nitra (Cliopatria row 'Nitra' 898-910), eu-15-a. This is the Moravian heir's appanage of 898-907, the same land as the Principality of Nitra of 825-833 but a different state; the two Cliopatria rows have different Wikidata ids (Q837326 and Q26397) so they stay separate dossiers. The 'vassal of Great Moravia (833-906/907)' of the infobox would make Nitra a vassal from 833; Great Moravia's dossier carries the vassal tie from 898 (appanage) because it gained Nitra directly in 833. End 907 follows the infobox (906/907); Cliopatria's 908-910 years are dropped. The Principality of Hungary's own Cliopatria shape starts 900 but excludes Nitra until 911: the Hungary dossier should take Nitra from 907. The Nitra page gives the bishopric established in Nitra in 880 (a church fact, not a border).
